verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers a digital platform (LathamDrive) with document generators and apps, so programmatic event subscriptions are a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or any event subscription mechanism. The probes found no API surface at all: llms.txt and every OpenAPI path returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
